summary: This Layer 2B chunk maps high-attention AI cloud and software reference tickers rather than underfollowed bottleneck candidates. MSFT, GOOGL, and AMZN are demand-anchor relationships: their AI capex, data-center buildout, custom silicon, networking, power, and cooling needs transmit demand to the more Serenity-relevant chokepoints identified in Layer 2A. PLTR and SNOW are software/data workflow references where the key research issue is not physical scarcity but AI revenue quality, durability, customer expansion, and valuation/expectations risk. No ticker in this chunk qualifies as an underfollowed alpha candidate; each should be used as a benchmark or falsification reference for smaller suppliers and niche AI workflow companies.
